title: SDG 13 氣候行動
footer: Teacher Dom · SDG #13 Climate Action 氣候行動

slides.eyebrow_en: A school in the middle of the fields

strip.en: the Zhuoshui River beside you, Taiwan's longest
strip.zh: 你們旁邊的濁水溪，全台最長

lines.en: Last class, we looked after each other.
lines.zh: 上一節，我們學習照顧彼此。

lines.en: This class, we look after our planet.
lines.zh: 這一節，我們來照顧我們的地球。

lines.en: The climate is changing — in California, and here in Changhua.
lines.zh: 氣候正在改變——在加州是這樣，在彰化也是。

slides.ask_en: Today: weather and climate, why the Earth is heating up, and what one small school can do.
slides.ask_zh: 今天要談：天氣與氣候、地球為什麼變熱，還有一所小學校能做什麼。

prompts.en: Stand up if you felt too hot in class this summer.
prompts.zh: 今年夏天在教室覺得太熱的，站起來。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you used a fan or AC last night.
prompts.zh: 昨晚有開電風扇或冷氣的，繼續站著。

prompts.en: Stay standing if you walked or biked somewhere this week.
prompts.zh: 這星期有走路或騎腳踏車出門的，繼續站著。

slides.punch_en: Everyone feels the weather. Today: something bigger — the climate.
slides.punch_zh: 每個人都感覺得到天氣。今天要談更大的事：氣候。

items.en: The Earth is warmer than 100 years ago
A typhoon is coming this weekend
Xizhou is warm most of the year
items.zh: 溪州一年到頭大多很溫暖

slides.note_en: Weather is today. Climate is many, many years.
slides.note_zh: 天氣是今天的事；氣候是很多、很多年的事。

slides.body_en: Gases in the air hold the sun's heat like a blanket — without it we would freeze. But burning oil, gas and coal makes the blanket thicker, and the Earth gets too warm.
slides.body_zh: 空氣裡的氣體像被子一樣留住太陽的熱——沒有它我們會凍僵。但燒石油、天然氣和煤，讓被子越來越厚，地球就太熱了。

slides.head_en: warmer: Taiwan today, compared with 110 years ago
slides.head_zh: 台灣現在比 110 年前熱了 1.6°C
slides.body_en: It sounds small. But think of your body: 37°C is fine — 38.6°C is a fever.
slides.body_zh: 聽起來很少。但想想你的身體：37°C 很正常，38.6°C 就是發燒了。
slides.ask_en: What happens to rice, fruit and fish when the whole island has a fever?
slides.ask_zh: 整座島都發燒的時候，稻米、水果和魚會怎麼樣？

slides.q_en: How long does summer last in Taiwan today?
slides.q_zh: 現在台灣的夏天有多長？
slides.explain_en: 120 to 150 days — and winter has shrunk to only about 20 to 40 days.
slides.explain_zh: 夏天長達 120 到 150 天，冬天則縮短到只剩大約 20 到 40 天。

slides.head_en: Your School Already Makes Clean Power
slides.head_zh: 你們學校已經在發乾淨的電
slides.ask_en: Look at your school from the sky: those blue roofs are solar panels. They turn sunshine into electricity — with no smoke at all.
slides.ask_zh: 從天空看你們學校：那些藍色的屋頂是太陽能板，把陽光變成電——完全不冒煙。

slides.body_en: Taiwan's largest landscape-tree nursery park is right here in Xizhou. Trees take in carbon dioxide, give shade and cool the air. Your township is already helping the whole island.
slides.body_zh: 全台灣面積最大的景觀苗木專區，就在溪州。樹會吸收二氧化碳、帶來樹蔭、讓空氣變涼。你們的家鄉，已經在幫整座島的忙。

slides.head_zh: 讓地球更熱，還是幫上忙？

items.en: Lights on in an empty room
A car waiting with its engine on
Using both sides of the paper

slides.note_en: Thumbs up for HELPS, thumbs down for HEATS UP!
slides.note_zh: 幫上忙比讚，更熱比倒讚！

slides.head_zh: 真的還假的？手比 ⭕ 或 ❌

items.en: Climate change is only a problem for polar bears.
items.zh: 氣候變遷只是北極熊的問題。
items.note_en: It changes rain, heat and harvests right here in Changhua.
items.note_zh: 它也改變彰化這裡的雨水、氣溫和收成。

items.note_en: Shade cools the ground, and leaves take in carbon dioxide.
items.note_zh: 樹蔭讓地面降溫，葉子還會吸收二氧化碳。

items.zh: 一個小小的行動沒有用。
items.note_en: Small actions become powerful when we work together.
items.note_zh: 當我們一起努力，小小的行動也會很有力量。

items.en: Walking a short trip saves energy.
items.zh: 短短的路用走的，可以節省能源。
items.note_en: No fuel burned — and it keeps your body active.
items.note_zh: 不用燒燃料，還能活動身體。

slides.q_en: The classroom is full of sunshine, but every light is on. What should you do?
slides.q_zh: 教室裡陽光很亮，燈卻全部開著。你應該怎麼做？

options.en: Turn them off and use the daylight

slides.explain_en: Turn off unused lights and use natural daylight whenever you can.
slides.explain_zh: 隨手關掉沒在用的燈，盡量利用自然光。

slides.rule_en: In 30 seconds, shout out as many things that use electricity as you can — in English. I will count!
slides.rule_zh: 30 秒內，用英文喊出越多「會用電的東西」越好，我來數！

slides.prompt_en: What is one thing our school could do to be cooler and greener?
slides.prompt_zh: 我們學校可以做哪一件事，變得更涼快、更綠？
slides.sentence_en: Our school could ______ to help the climate.
slides.sentence_zh: 我們學校可以 ______ 來幫助氣候。
slides.time_en: One minute each. Then I will ask two of you.
slides.time_zh: 每人一分鐘。然後我會請兩位分享。

slides.note_en: Watch and count: how many climate actions can you find?
slides.note_zh: 邊看邊數：影片裡有幾個氣候行動？

slides.head_en: 3 Things You Can Do This Week
slides.head_zh: 這週你可以做的 3 件事

items.en: Turn off lights you are not using — use the daylight.
items.zh: 關掉沒在用的燈——多用自然光。

items.en: Walk or ride a bike for short trips.
items.zh: 短短的路，用走的或騎腳踏車。

items.en: Water a tree — with rainwater if you can.
items.zh: 幫一棵樹澆水——可以的話，用雨水。

items.en: Weather is today. Climate is many years.
items.zh: 天氣是今天；氣候是很多年。

slides.q_en: In California, hotter and drier summers have made one danger much worse. Which one?
slides.q_zh: 在加州，夏天越來越熱、越來越乾，讓一種災害嚴重很多。是哪一種？
slides.explain_en: Wildfires. Dry forests burn fast. The climate is a problem for Dom's home and for yours — so we solve it together.
slides.explain_zh: 森林大火。乾燥的森林燒得很快。氣候是 Dom 家鄉的問題，也是你們家鄉的問題——所以要一起解決。

slides.body_en: Go to our School Tour page and find the Chengkung Elementary column. No sign-up, no login — tell me one climate action you will take.
slides.body_zh: 到我們網站的 School Tour 頁面，找到成功國小那一欄，免註冊、免登入，告訴我你會做的一個氣候行動。

slides.big_en:
Small actions become powerful
when we work together.
slides.big_zh:
當我們一起努力，
小小的行動也會很有力量。
